native_method: Two fresh IDA GUI runs. 100 samples per warm operation per case per run; cold timings are single samples per case per run. Table uses larger values from the two runs. Working-set deltas are noisy process-level estimates, not allocation/peak measures.
limits: Native prototype only: grouped model list, search, thinking combo, footer label, retained draft. Not integrated production provider/model activation.
Full native Workspace/Settings redesign, long chat/tool output, provider network and SDK initialization costs were not benchmarked.
Synchronous UI processing plus event pumping is not input-to-screen compositor latency.
Native opening varied materially between runs; source of variation not isolated.
Idle measurements cover whole IDA process, three paired intervals, not isolated popup CPU.
